versions.changelog:
Initial release providing up-to-date Ethereum development knowledge and addressing common misconceptions:

- Covers recent Ethereum upgrades (Pectra, Fusaka) and L2 landscape
- Explains major protocol changes: ERC-8004 (onchain agent identity) and x402 (HTTP payments)
- Provides current 2026 gas prices, ETH value, and real-world transaction costs
- Details key differences between Ethereum and Solana, with agent-focused context
- Lists available sub-skills for gas, wallets, L2s, standards, tools, DeFi, contract addresses, security, and frontend development
